title: Explore Canvas
subtitle: Your own infinite canvas: ask freely, learn freely, explore freely, doodle freely
moveToTrashBody: “{{title}}” goes to the canvas trash for 30 days; its pages and portfolio entries are untouched.
trashRowHint: Removed {{time}}; destroyed with its pages after 30 days
emptyList: No canvases yet — create one at the top right
organizeBody: Realign cards into rows and columns (drawings, arrows and images stay untouched).
clearBody: Current content is archived to the timeline first, so you can undo it there.
histEmpty: No snapshots yet: editing auto-archives every 30 minutes; restoring also saves current first
restoreTitle: Replace this page with that moment?
restoreBody: Your current content is archived first, so you can come back.
statsPrivacyNote: Stats cover usage behavior only (counts and times) — never question content or canvas content. Students’ expression space stays private.
careNote: Questions expressing self-harm or suicidal thoughts are answered with a fixed care script and an alert is sent. Only student, count and time are shown here — never the question text. "Model flagged" means the risk was inferred, not stated outright.
careFlagTip: Not said outright — the model inferred the risk and sent a signal
shareTip: Create a read-only snapshot of this page for your teachers (auto-expires; revocable anytime)
shareModalTitle: Share this page with your teachers
shareNamePh: Share title (optional, defaults to canvas + page)
sharePrivacy: Teachers only see this read-only snapshot — later edits stay private; it auto-expires and you can revoke it any time in My shares.
tplTip: Publish this page into the shared template library
tplModalTitle: Publish this page as a template
tplPrivacy: A template is a starter page anyone can copy with one click; you can remove it any time.
tplDeleteConfirm: Remove this template? Copies already made are unaffected.
tplEmpty: This page is empty — add something before publishing
sharesEmptyMine: You have not shared anything yet
sharesEmptyIn: No student has shared a canvas with you yet
shareErrForbidden: This share is only visible to its owner and that student's teachers
shareErrExpired: This share has expired or been revoked
shareErrLoad: Failed to load, try again later
breakBody: You have been exploring for {{n}} minutes. Stand up and stretch — your canvas will wait.
tooFewCards: Not enough cards to tidy up
clearDone: Cleared. Use Timeline to bring it back
shareEmpty: This page is empty — add something before sharing
shareDone: Read-only snapshot created, valid until {{date}}; you can revoke anytime
archEmpty: This page is empty — add something before archiving
histDone: Rewound to that moment; the version you just had is also in the timeline
delPageTitle: Move this page to the page trash?
delPageBody: The tab disappears, but its snapshot and timeline are kept — restore within 30 days.
nearLimit: Canvas is close to the size limit: remove large images or continue on a new page
draftFoundBody: The last save did not complete. Using the local draft overwrites the cloud version; choosing the cloud version discards the draft.
micDenied: Cannot access the microphone; check browser permissions
pickFail: Failed to load daily picks, try again
partialTts: Some paragraphs could not be synthesized
askCardSaved: Saved as a question card — circle it to keep asking, or use follow-up/read-aloud on the card
pickPasted: Pick pasted — circle it and ask "is this true?" or "tell me more"
photoPasted: Photo added to the canvas — circle it to ask the AI
tplEmptyHint: Built-in examples above are always available; teacher-published templates will appear here too.
builtinProblemDesc: Pile up your questions, circle any card to keep asking the AI
builtinInquiryDesc: Three columns: what I know / what I ask / what I found — plus a one-line conclusion
builtinLessonDesc: Objectives, concepts, worked example, practice, homework — good for teaching and archiving
histHint: The canvas keeps an automatic copy of this page every so often. Choose “Rewind” to replace the page with that version — your current work is saved first, so you can come back.
archiveTip: Export this page as an image into your portfolio
clearTip: Clear this page; it is saved to the timeline first, so you can get it back
pageTrashTip: Deleted pages live here for 30 days — snapshot and timeline are kept
pageTrashed: Moved to the page trash — restore it from the tab bar within 30 days
archEmptyList: Nothing archived yet: press “Save to Portfolio” on a canvas page
archDropConfirm: Remove this item from your portfolio?
archDropBody: Only the portfolio entry is removed — the canvas page and its timeline stay untouched.
micTipOn: Done talking? Tap again to stop and transcribe
micTipOff: Dictate your question (server speech recognition, admin-enabled)
ctxSelected: {{n}} items selected — they will be included in your question
ctxCircle: You just drew a circle — whatever is inside comes along
ctxExtracted: Text from inside the circle is in the box — send it as is, or edit it
ctxPlaced: The circled content is in the box — send it as is, or edit it
msgTopicDone: “{{title}}” is on the canvas — circle any block to keep asking
panelIntro: Type a topic, press Map / Stars to spread it out, then circle anything to ask.
dropCanvasTip: Place it on the canvas so it can be circled again
locateTip: Find this card on the canvas
askPh: What do you want to ask? Circle the content first for a sharper answer
mindmapTip: Type a topic to build a mind map
topicmapTip: Type one word to spread a whole star map (intro + 5 follow-ups)
genimgTip: Turn the topic into a picture
pickTip: Paste a daily pick onto the canvas
photoTip: Take a photo, drop it on the canvas, circle it to ask
pickModalTitle: Which pick goes on the canvas?
followupPrefix: About “{{q}}”, I also want to ask:
aiFabTip: Open the AI assistant (ask / draw / say / paste)
